runtime.name: python
runtime.source: docs do not say; a newcomer installs the current LTS

prereqs.command: command -v uv >/dev/null || { if command -v pip >/dev/null || command -v pip3 >/dev/null; then (pip install uv || pip3 install uv); else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh; fi; }

steps.command: cd backend && uv run bash scripts/prestart.sh

prereqs.command: command -v bun >/dev/null || { if command -v npm >/dev/null; then npm install -g bun; else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq unzip curl >/dev/null && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && ln -sf "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun; fi; }

knownFailures.cause: `uv` is not installed; the docs assume it is.

knownFailures.signature: bash: scripts/prestart.sh: No such file or directory
knownFailures.cause: `uv run bash scripts/prestart.sh` must run inside `backend/` (the file is `backend/scripts/prestart.sh`), but the docs never say to change into that folder.
knownFailures.fix: cd backend && uv run bash scripts/prestart.sh

knownFailures.cause: `bun` is not installed; the docs assume it is.
